text.en:
Weapon Kills grant 10% increased damage for 7 seconds.

Grenade or Melee Kills grant 20%|30% increased damage for 7 seconds. Can activate while stowed.

Weapon Kills refresh the buff duration.

Weapon Kills grant 10% increased damage for 7 seconds.

Grenade or Melee Kills grant 20% increased damage for 7 seconds. Scoring another Grenade or Melee Kill increases this to 30%. Can activate while stowed.

Weapon Kills refresh the buff duration.

Weapon Kills grant 10% increased damage for 7 seconds (x1 Stack).

Grenade or Melee Kills grant 20% increased damage for 7 seconds (x2). Scoring another Grenade or Melee Kill increases this to 30% (x3).

Can activate while stowed. Weapon Kills refresh the buff duration.

Weapon Kills grant 'Desperate Measures x1' (DMx1), increasing damage by 10% for 7 seconds.

Grenade or Melee Kills grant 20% increased damage for 7 seconds (DMx2). Scoring another Grenade or Melee Kill with DMx2 active increases this to 30% (DMx3).

Can activate while stowed. Weapon, Grenade, and Melee Kills refresh the buff duration.

Grenade or Melee Kills grant 20% increased damage for #e${7+#d} seconds (DMx2). Scoring another Grenade or Melee Kill with DMx2 active increases this to 30% (DMx3).

Can be activated while stowed. Weapon, Grenade, and Melee Kills refresh the buff duration.
